links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of existing survival prediction models on external multicenter Chinese data
links.effect: SORG ML AUC 0.765 for 90-day survival; revised Tokuhashi 0.754 at 180 days; revised Katagiri 0.806 at 1 year; nearly all models underestimated survival probabilities, particularly in high-risk subgroups.
links.quote: However, nearly all models exhibited underestimation of survival probabilities, particularly in high-risk subgroups.

links.outcome: Need for recalibration of models when applied to a new population
links.effect: Existing models underestimated survival; authors conclude recalibration is needed, particularly in East Asian populations.
links.quote: However, recalibration is needed to address underestimation, particularly in East Asian populations.

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter external validation of existing clinical and machine learning prognostic systems (including SORG ML) without testing a specific implementation or deployment practice.
